# IrqRearm

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Unmasks a device's interrupt line after BindIrq() delivered it.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x08` SVC_MANAGEHANDLE | `MNGHNDL_IRQ_REARM (6)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err IrqRearm(Handle dev_handle);
```

**Registers:** `(device) -> r0 status`

Clear the interrupt in the device first, or it fires again immediately.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dev_handle` | in | Device handle with PERM_MAP whose interrupt this space bound. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `dev_handle` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `dev_handle` is not a device. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | The device has no interrupt. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `dev_handle` lacks PERM_MAP, or this space did not bind the interrupt. |
